ūru: ūru [Vedic ūru; cp. Lat. vārus bow--legged, of Idg. *ṷā, to which also Ohg. wado = Ger. wade calf of leg] the thigh Sn 610; Vin II.105 (in contrast with bāha); III. 106; J I.277; II.275, 443; III.82; V.89, 155; Nd2 659 (so read for uru); Vv 6413; DA I.135 = Vin II.190.--aṭṭhi(ka) the thigh bone M I.58; III.92; J I.428 (ūraṭṭhika); KhA 49, 50 (ūraṭṭhi). --(k)khambha stiffening or rigidity of the thigh, paralysis of the leg (as symptom of fright) M I.237; J V.23.
